The recommended shelf life is 6 months from the date of packing, however, this can be extended with proper storage. For best results, store matcha in an airtight container, away from heat, light, moisture, and strong odours. To preserve flavour, aroma, colour, and nutritional integrity, all matcha is stored at -20°C from the time of first harvest until it is packed for shipping. This ultra-low temperature storage helps maintain the freshness and quality of the tea right up until it reaches you. Storing Matcha Matcha is delicate. Its vibrant color, fresh aroma, and smooth flavor can quickly fade if not stored correctly. A few simple habits will keep your matcha at its best. Use an Airtight Container: Exposure to air is one of matcha’s biggest enemies. Always transfer your matcha into a clean, airtight container as soon as possible. This helps preserve its flavor, color, and nutritional quality by protecting it from oxidation. Store It in the Freezer: To keep your matcha fresh for longer, store it in the freezer. The cold temperature slows down the natural processes that cause matcha to lose its flavor, aroma, and bright green color. Freezing helps because: Cold slows chemical reactions, so oxidation happens much more slowly. Flavor and aroma are preserved longer, especially those fresh, grassy notes. Color stays vibrant due to less degradation of chlorophyll. Unlike many foods, matcha freezes exceptionally well because it is completely dry. There is no water inside the powder to form ice crystals, so its texture remains unchanged. As long as moisture is kept out, the matcha will stay fine, smooth, and easy to sift. When using frozen matcha, allow the container to come to room temperature before opening. This prevents condensation from forming, which can introduce moisture and cause clumping. A small note: Matcha is best enjoyed fresh. Proper storage simply helps preserve its quality, so every cup tastes as it should. While there's some friendly rivalry with New Zealand over various food origins, the lamington is widely acknowledged as an Australian creation. What makes a lamington a lamington? Three essential elements define a lamington: sponge cake, chocolate coating, and a layer of desiccated coconut. We migrated from UK to Australia and have called Sydney our home ever since. We have been welcomed with open arms by the community and believe we are in one of the best countries in the world! Having worked in the corporate world for a long time, the pandemic proved to be a pivotal moment as it allowed us time to reflect on the purpose of life, what we enjoy doing and how best we could serve the community. Being passionate about food, entertainment, helping others and having a corporate background made us believe that the hospitality industry is worth a shot, and we have not looked back since! EXPLORE NOW Our Venue We are big nature lovers and strongly believe being closer to nature is the way to attain Nirvana! Nature has been our inspiration for the café theme, and it is reflected in the rustic farmhouse vibe we have created for the café’. Everything else is aligned with it – the colorful floral ambiance, the music, the simplicity and freshness in our food, the diversity of our offerings & our focus on sustainability through reuse of recycled building materials. Our USP is undoubtedly the overall experience that we provide our customers when they visit us. It starts with a friendly service having a high level of empathy for our customers. Next is our food which is visually appealing yet healthy, fresh and flavourful. It this combination which really helps us stand out as most other venues struggle to get a tick in all the boxes. Our menu is diverse with over 30 items across a range of price points and also blends other cuisines. In addition, we do High Tea and offer a variety of hot and cold drinks including mocktails and cocktails which are not usually available in cafes. Last but not the least, it is the unique vibe! Ideally, we would like all our customers to leave the cafe having attained a state of Nirvana – complete bliss! Our focus is on touching all 5 senses through our food, drinks, service, music and the ambiance in a manner that delights our customers wanting them to not only come back again but also recommend us to their family and friends! EXPLORE NOW Our Flavours We believe in the adage that we are what we eat! Therefore, the basis of all our menu items has been simplicity, freshness & flavour. While the first two are important, the third is crucial for the palette! We blend the modern Australian cuisine with flavours inspired from Middle Eastern, Oriental and South Asian cuisines and therefore they also resonate well with the diverse communities here. Our creations go through multiple iterations with select customer groups, before we launch it to all our customers. Each of our creation is irresistibly chic with the right fusion of colors to create the picture-perfect moment. Our dishes are made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients that celebrate the best of Australian produce. Given we draw a lot of young people and families, providing a nutritious & balanced meal is a key focus in all our dishes. EXPLORE NOW Our Community The response from the local community since we opened doors till date has been overwhelmingly positive. This is testament to the fact that we have been in business for more than 8 years now! We are thankful for the love and support shown by the community but also their friends and families that visit us from all over Australia and the rest of the world when they are in Sydney! Our engagement with the local community is at multiple levels, from celebrating key occasions and festivals through special offers & dishes. Most recently we celebrated the tremendous performance at the Olympics by the Australian team by creating a special pancake in their honor. We also support other local businesses by promoting their products/services through our café outlets/ providing sponsorships/ gift vouchers. Our local community is our lifeblood. Needless to say, their love and support is crucial for our continued success and their constructive feedback helps us improve even further. EXPLORE NOW

Just as coffee and wine cultures that developed in Australia in their unique and original ways, bread culture introduced to Japan from the West has evolved in its own unique style, taking on board what the Japanese wanted to see in bread. In recent days, “Shokupan” the most standard bread loaves in the Japanese everyday lifestyle have shown noticeable advancement and the hotly-talked-about flavour is a result of hard work and continuous research by the numerous bakers in Japan. AKIPAN have thoroughly studied the new wave Shokupan, reviewed the ingredients and processes and researched how we can recreate this here in Sydney. In order to replicate the bread-making in Japan, AKIPAN brought most of the tools needed for bread-making from Japan. These include brushes ideal for applying butter, accurate scales that show numbers instantly, and Shokupan loaf tins developed in Japan for perfect heat conduction. They are all products of Japan’s great manufacturing technology and directly affects the flavour of the bread loaves. Furthermore, in order to produce the ultimate Shokupan, AKIPAN had to work on finding the perfect balance of ingredients, as well as the methodology that works here in Sydney while adhering to the techniques and ingredients established in Japan. As a result, we managed to produce AKIPAN’s bread loaves that are Japanese style and yet highly original and cannot be bought from anywhere else. It is our mission to add a new page to Sydney’s “food” scenes that is evolving at an unprecedented speed and bring to you the flavour of “Shokupan” which was not available in Australia until now.

STITCH COFFEE was born of an idea that coffee doesn’t need to be a standalone - it can be mixed together. We realised at an early stage that the art of blending coffee is the same as tailoring a piece of cloth. As a result, we stitched together origins with different flavours to bring forward the ultimate cup characteristics for everyone to enjoy. Daring, bold and unconventional, we aim to break the mould and bring specialty coffee to all. Sharing this craft and its fine coffee products is all for your enjoyment at home and beyond. We do this by creating connections with our suppliers and consumers from the very beginning of the coffee supply chain to the very end of the consumption process. With a focus on ensuring that consumers know about and have transparency about the entire coffee journey. We share information so that every participant in the coffee process succeeds, and our industry continues to thrive for decades to come. Innovation is one of our passions, bringing you coffee products that enable special moments shared over coffee. And we want this to happen anywhere and whenever, be it from our Broadway flagship store, in the comfort of your home or even when you are on the go! Bringing specialty coffee into every part of what we do starts with us ensuring that our wholesale customers (cafes and retailers) are knowledgeable through our coaching-style relationship. This helps to upskill them so that their offerings to you are of the highest level with a perfect cup of coffee, no matter the brewing method. We have become well known within our industry as a Specialty Coffee Roaster that is bold, fun and quality focused. We rotate single origins from all over the globe in an effort to bring variety and share knowledge with our consumers, as a platform to promote the work of coffee farmers across the continents. No favourites and no specialisation of region, but a focus on the farmer / producer – no matter where they were located. This is what makes up our community and feeds into our why, why we do what we do, why we exist. From pickers, farmers to roasters and coffee addicts, we are here to bring people together through coffee. “WE ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT CREATING UNIQUE, DELICIOUS COFFEE FROM AROUND THE WORLD AND TO CONNECT THESE WITH OUR CONSUMERS AS WE CELEBRATE THE WORK OF COFFEE PRODUCERS AND ALL THOSE ACROSS THE COFFEE JOURNEY. COFFEE TO US, IS A CRAFT ONLY POSSIBLE BY BRINGING COMMUNITIES TOGETHER.” OUR ORIGIN STORY At STITCH COFFEE we believe that coffee is much like a tapestry - it is a weaving of origins and flavours to create a delicious cup. Nawar Adra, owner and founder of STITCH COFFEE, had humble beginnings working as a barista in the iconic Western Sydney Suburbs cafe Circa Espresso. This is where Nawar started his roasting journey when Circa purchased their very own Probat P5 roaster for in-house production. During his time there, the focus was only on single origin coffees. However, Nawar gradually realised there was an artistry within the blending of origins. This merging of origins created a cup with distinct complexity, structure, and balance. The concept gave birth to STITCH COFFEE. We opened the doors to our roastery in 2015 and haven’t looked back. Today we are a company dedicated to creating connections through coffee, from green bean importers, to everyday coffee drinkers and everyone in between. Part of our offering goes beyond our coffee. It includes assisting cafes in up-skilling their baristas and teams, training them on extracting the perfect espresso and brew a delicious pour-over. Our love for coffee is fed by the daily home brewers and the cafes that serve our coffee, which is why education and knowledge sharing is so important for us. We will continue to source coffee ethically from around the world and ensure that we have the ability to communicate this with our community. We are continuously evolving our buying practises and fostering relationships with importers and farmers to ensure a healthy future for coffee. DIVERSITY & INCLUSIVITY It all starts with the heart of our company: our team. Our team members come from many countries and cultures, and that allows us to have a wide range of perspectives. Many points of view that come together and are stitched together into one big family. We believe in everyone’s potential to succeed by being a supportive workplace and setting our team up for success, just as we do with our business goals. SUSTAINABILITY & ETHICAL SOURCING STITCH COFFEE strive to forge a strong and long-lasting relationship with green bean importers who value sustainability as much as we do. We believe in empowering the entire supply chain in this industry and together make it better. Read more about our sustainability practices here. We are a highly visual brand, our packaging looks pretty nice (if we do say so ourselves) and we also want to be kind to our world. For the last few years we have endeavoured to move towards making our packaging recyclable and reduce waste all-round. We are proud to say we are good and clean for our planet, presenting new ways to package coffee that are different to other coffee products whilst maintaining the quality of the cup you brew COMMUNITY & COLLABORATION The coffee community is our why. From pickers, farmers to roasters and coffee addicts, we are here to bring people together through coffee. The ideology that we operate on is - If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together (African proverb). When one part of our community succeeds, we all do. We advocate on behalf of our fellow roasters to help them access great quality green beans. This is the power of co-roasting! Our co-roasting initiatives are powered by our sister BRAND ECRE. Find out more about it here. We support our wholesale customers with continuous training, connection to suppliers and business advice. We believe we only succeed when we stick together – or stitch together. GROWTH & EXPANSION We are bold, we are trailblazers, we thrive off being daring, unconventional and pushing boundaries. Never afraid to go big, go first and go where others don’t venture. ‘First movers’ is our favourite combo of words and although we are not always the first, we are a leader in the coffee industry. We innovate in a wide range of products and offer something for all types of coffee lovers. Innovation never ends as we don’t want to miss a beat to continually move forward, to better ourselves, learn and grow, whilst making it accessible to the specialty coffee industry.
